Both acceleration and direct were tried: the relay limits requests per IP, so waiting a minute or two before refreshing usually works; direct access is capped at GitHub's 60 requests per hour.
Rel.Advice.Switch: 打开「设置 → 网络 → GitHub 加速服务」可以换一条出口——中转端有自己的配额，不用等直连那 60 次/小时恢复。
Turning on GitHub acceleration under Settings → Network switches to another route — the relay has its own quota, so you do not have to wait for the 60-per-hour direct limit.
